# New sprint

> Plans a Gradatim project's next sprint as a board of tasks in the order of work, or adds a task to the open sprint. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's new sprint step, to plan the next sprint, or to add a task or an urgent bug to the open sprint.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `new-sprint`, [its file](../../skills/new-sprint/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 6 of 14: new sprint |
| Runs | When no sprint is open; "add a task" any time |
| Next | design task |
| Call it | `/gradatim:new-sprint` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's new sprint step, to plan the next sprint, or to open the first one.
- The user asks to add a task to the open sprint: an urgent bug, or work split off a task.
- Not for a change to a story, the cut, the roadmap's order or an estimate: that is [`write-concept`](write-concept.md). Not for the stack, the structure or a module: that is [`write-architecture`](write-architecture.md). Not for a change of direction: that is [`decide-direction`](decide-direction.md). Not for designing a task: that is [`design-task`](design-task.md). Not for closing a sprint: that is [`close-sprint`](close-sprint.md). Not for a folder with no Gradatim project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads |
| Decisions index | `docs/decisions/README.md` | reads |
| MVP | `docs/MVP.md` | reads |
| Roadmap | `docs/ROADMAP.md` | reads |
| Phase | `docs/PHASE-<k>.md` | reads |
| Architecture | `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | reads |
| Agent docs | `docs/agents/<topic>.md` | reads |
| Release record | `docs/RELEASES.md` | reads |
| Sprint rules and index | `docs/sprints/README.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Sprint README | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/README.md` | reads, creates, changes |
| Task file | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/<ID>-<slug>.md` | reads, creates |
| Issue | `docs/issues/YYYY-MM-DD-<ID>-<topic>.md` | reads, changes |
| Deferred item | `docs/deferred-items/YYYY-MM-DD-<origin>-<topic>.md` | reads, changes |

It changes the rules, the items and the issues only at the yes. It writes nothing to git, and runs no sync.
